data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Khuzama', meaning 'soldier' or 'warrior'. In Islamic context, it represents the one who fights for the cause of God. The name Khuzamah carries the meaning “Soldier of God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khuzamah usually hope their child will grow to embody soldier of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

It is a reminder to strive towards spiritual growth and keep the battle against one's own ego, temptations, and weaknesses, just as a soldier fights against an external enemy. It encourages individuals to be steadfast in their faith and to remain committed to their spiritual journey despite the challenges and hardships. It also symbolizes the collective struggle of the Muslim community to preserve its values and traditions in the face of adversity.
